example: Better training usually translates into fewer mistakes.
exampleZh: 更好的培訓通常會帶來較少錯誤。

examples.en: Better training usually translates into fewer mistakes.
examples.zh: 更好的培訓通常會帶來較少錯誤。
examples.highlight: Better training usually translates into fewer mistakes.

rules.zh: 這裏的 translate into 表示「帶來實際結果」更好的培訓會帶來較少錯誤。 這項投資帶來了更高的銷售額。 這個用法常用於談論：改善帶來的成果投資帶來的回報政策帶來的改變資料所反映的實際影響技能在現實環境中的應用抽象概念所產生的具體結果
rules.en: Better training translates into fewer mistakes. The investment translated into higher sales.

rules.zh: 不要與「翻譯語言」的用法混淆語言翻譯：【The translator translated the report into English.】 翻譯員把報告翻譯成英文。 結構：【Subject + translate + object + into + language】 表示實際結果：【Better planning translates into fewer delays.】 更好的規劃會帶來較少延誤。 結構：【Subject + translate into + result】 第二種用法通常沒有直接受詞。
rules.en: The translator translated the report into English. Subject + translate + object + into + language Better planning translates into fewer delays. Subject + translate into + result

rules.zh: 後面接名詞或名詞短語正確：【translate into fewer mistakes；translate into higher sales；translate into better performance；translate into real progress；translate into practical benefits】 本課不使用完整子句接在 into 後面。避免：【The training translates into employees make fewer mistakes.】 應改為：【The training translates into fewer mistakes.】 培訓會帶來較少錯誤。
rules.en: Into translate into fewer mistakes translate into higher sales translate into better performance translate into real progress translate into practical benefits The training translates into employees make fewer mistakes. The training translates into fewer mistakes.

rules.zh: 主語通常是能夠產生結果的事情常見主語包括：【better training；regular practice；higher costs；improved technology；greater public awareness；a new policy；additional investment；lower prices】 主語不一定是人。它通常是一項改變、行動、條件、政策、投資或抽象概念。
rules.en: better training regular practice higher costs improved technology greater public awareness a new policy additional investment lower prices stronger teamwork reliable information

rules.zh: 不一定表示結果必然發生說話者可以利用情態動詞和副詞控制語氣。更好的培訓會帶來較少錯誤。 這個說法較肯定。更好的培訓可以帶來較少錯誤。 這個說法表示可能性。更好的培訓通常會帶來較少錯誤。 這個說法表示結果經常發生，但並非每次都必然發生。更好的培訓並不一定每次都會帶來較少錯誤。 這個說法清楚保留限制。
rules.en: Translate into Better training translates into fewer mistakes. Better training can translate into fewer mistakes. Better training usually translates into fewer mistakes. Better training does not always translate into fewer mistakes.

rules.zh: 必須使用 into，而不是 to 正確：【Better service translates into greater customer loyalty.】 錯誤：【Better service translates to greater customer loyalty.】 在本課所教的「帶來實際結果」用法中，使用 translate into。
rules.en: Better service translates into greater customer loyalty. Better service translates to greater customer loyalty.

rules.zh: 其他資料只是可選延伸，不是固定表達的一部分；核心句型是：【X translates into + noun phrase】 完整句子：【More visitors translate into more sales.】 更多訪客會帶來更多銷售。 可以加入額外資料：【For local shops, more visitors often translate into more sales.】 對本地商店而言，更多訪客往往會帶來更多銷售。 長遠而言，更好的習慣可以帶來重大改善。 短語 for local shops 和 over time 只是補充資料，不是固定句型的一部分。一般現在式：定期練習會帶來更大的自信。 一般過去式：較低成本帶來了更高利潤。 完成式：這些改革已帶來更安全的工作環境。 情態動詞：新制度可能會帶來較短的輪候時間。 否定句：額外努力並沒有帶來更好的成果。 疑問句：較高薪金是否一定會帶來更強的工作動力？
rules.en: X translates into + noun phrase More visitors translate into more sales. For local shops, more visitors often translate into more sales. Over time, better habits can translate into major improvements. Subject + translate(s) into + noun phrase Regular practice translates into greater confidence. Subject + translated into + noun phrase The lower costs translated into greater profits. Subject + has / have translated into + noun phrase The reforms have translated into safer working conditions. Subject + can / may / might / could / should / will + translate into + noun phrase The new system may translate into shorter waiting times. Subject + does / did not translate into + noun phrase The extra effort did not translate into better results. Does / Can / Will + subject + translate into + noun phrase? Does a higher salary always translate into stronger motivation?

rules.zh: 這些改變預計會帶來更好的公共服務。
rules.en: Be likely / expected / beginning to Subject + be + likely / expected / beginning + to translate into + noun phrase The changes are expected to translate into better public services.

rules.zh: 在條件句、讓步句和 whether 從句中如果計劃能帶來實質進展，公眾支持便會增加。
rules.en: If X translates into Y,... Although X did not translate into Y,... Whether X translates into Y depends on... If the plan translates into real progress, public support will increase.

rules.zh: 在關係子句中我們需要能帶來實際好處的改善。
rules.en: noun + that / which + translate(s) into + noun phrase We need improvements that translate into real benefits.

benefits.zh: 清楚連接「改變」和「實際結果」這個句型可以把一項行動、政策或改善與它所產生的結果直接連接起來。更好的培訓通常會帶來較少錯誤。 讀者可以立即看出：起因：better training 實際結果：fewer mistakes
benefits.en: Better training usually translates into fewer mistakes.

benefits.zh: 把抽象概念變成具體成果有些詞語比較抽象，例如：【investment；awareness；efficiency；training；technology；planning】 使用 translate into，可以說明這些抽象概念在現實中帶來甚麼具體成果。更高效率可以帶來較短的輪候隊伍。 這樣比只說 “Efficiency is important” 更具體。
benefits.en: investment awareness efficiency training technology planning Greater efficiency can translate into shorter queues.

benefits.zh: 適合分析、報告和商業寫作這個句型特別適合用於：報告數據分析商業建議簡報學術寫作政策討論工作表現評估例如：【The lower production costs should translate into lower prices for customers.】 較低的生產成本應會為顧客帶來較低價格。 句子清楚說明成本改變會產生甚麼實際影響。
benefits.en: The lower production costs should translate into lower prices for customers.

benefits.zh: 幫助控制說法的強弱你可以加入：【can；may；should；often；usually；not always；not necessarily；automatically】 來避免把不確定的結果說成必然事實。更高的公眾意識不會自動帶來行為上的改變。
benefits.en: can may should often usually not always not necessarily automatically Greater awareness does not automatically translate into changes in behaviour.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 lead to 和 result in 不用每次都寫：【leads to；results in；causes；produces】 你可以使用 translate into，增加句式變化。兩句意思相近，但第二句特別強調投資產生了可觀察的實際成果。
benefits.en: leads to results in causes produces The investment led to higher sales. The investment translated into higher sales.
